title: District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission

content.scenario: A consumer dispute could not be settled by mediation. The District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission must continue to hear all the issues involved in such a consumer dispute.
content.outcome: The District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission must continue to hear all the issues involved in such a consumer dispute, as the consumer dispute could not be settled by mediation.
